source: Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University — UAS Research Guide
description: Curated registry of research databases referenced by ERAU's UAS guide. Most are subscription resources (no automated mining); the public ones (DTIC, NTRL, HSDL) are viable enrichment targets for technical reports, program data, and citations.

databases.name: DTIC Online: Public Technical Reports
databases.content: Declassified DoD and government-funded technical documents
databases.notes: Free public search + bulk APIs. High-value for platform program history and test reports.

databases.name: National Technical Reports Library (NTRL)
databases.content: U.S. government-funded scientific and technical information from 200+ agencies
databases.notes: Free public access. Good for cross-referencing program names and contractors.

databases.name: Homeland Security Digital Library (HSDL)
databases.content: Security and cybersecurity policy documents from government and institutional sources
databases.notes: Public collection is open; some items require an account. Relevant to counter-UAS / DFR policy.

databases.name: Janes
databases.content: Aircraft specifications, defense reviews, aerospace publications
databases.notes: Authoritative platform specs but paywalled. Use as a manual cross-check citation only.

databases.name: Advanced Technologies & Aerospace Database
databases.content: Citations, abstracts, and some full text for aeronautics, astronautics, computing, and technical reports
databases.notes: ProQuest. Citation enrichment via institutional access only.

databases.name: ScienceDirect
databases.content: Scholarly journals and ebooks in engineering and physical sciences
databases.notes: Elsevier. Some open-access articles are individually mineable; bulk is paywalled.

databases.name: Scopus
databases.content: Abstracts and citations across life, health, physical, and social sciences
databases.notes: Elsevier. API exists but requires an institutional key.

databases.name: Business Source Complete
databases.content: Industry journals, trade publications, market research, business analysis
databases.notes: EBSCO. Useful for company/market intel but paywalled.

databases.name: International Security & Counter Terrorism Reference Center
databases.content: Articles and reports on security and terrorism, military and economic perspectives
